dedupe_keys.name: galicia and murcia survey of recycled water acceptance

description: This collection contains 726 survey responses about recycled-water acceptance in Galicia and Murcia, Spanish regions with contrasting water scarcity. Sergio Vila-Tojo and collaborators measure environmental diagnoses, values and perceptions relevant to high-contact and low-contact reuse options. Respondents were recruited through an online market-research panel with proportional sex and age sampling. Mendeley version 5 provides Excel, SPSS and DAT representations, a survey PDF and statistical results, free under CC BY 4.0. The accessible metadata do not establish the exact fieldwork dates. Coverage is limited to two regions. Paid panel participation and stated preferences limit interpretation as observed behaviour or acceptance throughout Spain. A reviewer-assessed use is exploring how public acceptance could constrain wastewater-reuse adoption in water-allocation or household-agent simulations. platform-sei-weap-water-evaluation-and-adaptation-planning supplies a related physical allocation environment, but the survey is not a directly executable demand module. No individual responses, regression coefficients or survey weighting calculations were independently checked.
